CURRENT SCENE:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P251] 所以他们找到了很多植物【对】药
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以他们找到了很多植物[对→当]药 (当药 means “use as medicine”)
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 他找到了很多[有用植物→有用的植物]
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 可是[他找到毒的植物→找到的是有毒的植物]
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 所以神农走了很长的时间找到[植物药→能做药的植物]
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.

[P252] 【神农】先看到很多病人
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦神农⟧先看到很多病人 (first appearance of 神农: briefly introduce who this is)
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦神农⟧看了很多生病的人 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

[P253] 他们吃很多植物【对】药
  proposed by the AI checker: 他们吃很多植物[对→当]药 (当药 means “use as medicine”)
  proposed by the correction model: 他们吃很多植物[-对]药
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 他们吃[毒→有毒的]植物
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 吃很多[-的]植物
  her past correction (le_completed): 他尝[+了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P254] 但是我觉得他们【的】吃的植物

  proposed by the correction model: 但是我觉得他们[-的]吃的植物

Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. Not an error: Do not flag a word or sentence under this rule only because of grammar or vocabulary. Flag it here when it changes or adds a fact in the traditional story.

[P255] 让他们【病人】
  proposed by the AI checker: 让他们[病人→生病] (让人生病 means “make someone ill”)
  her past correction (missing_or_unclear_subject): [+他]就生病了 — her note: otherwise it is ambiguous who gets sick
  her past correction (other): [人→你们]正好生病还是百草让他们生病了
  her past correction (no_le_with_mei): 和他[没病了→病好了] — her note: 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb
  rule card missing_or_unclear_subject: State the Subj. when leaving it out would make it unclear who does the action. Restate the Subj. after a different Subj. or an inserted “narrator comment” before returning to the main story. Not an error: Do not flag an omitted subject when the previous subject can clearly continue. A subject needs to be restated when the previous subject cannot continue or would cause ambiguity.
  rule card no_le_with_mei: After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了. Not an error: This rule is for 没/没有 + an action verb. Do not apply it when the word after 没 is not an action verb, as in 没病了.

[P256] 神农觉得这个植物【可能】特别是毒
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 神农觉得这个植物[可能→，这样可以]特别是毒 (her pattern: 可能 -> ，这样可以 (corrected 9/14 in train))
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 神农现在知道哪个植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 特别是[毒的→有毒的]植物
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 他说：“很多植物[可以是毒→可能有毒]
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”

[P257] 神农觉得这个植物可能特别【是毒】
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农觉得这个植物可能特别[是→有]毒 (特别有毒 is the correct predicate)
  proposed by the correction model: 神农觉得这个植物可能特别[是→有]毒
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 神农觉得这个植物可能特别[是毒→有毒] (her pattern: 是毒 -> 有毒 (corrected 14/15 in train))
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 神农现在知道哪个植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 神农看到很多人吃了[麻烦的→有害的]植物
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 他说：“很多植物[可以是毒→可能有毒]
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”
  rule card near_synonym_precision: Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness. Not an error: Do not flag a word simply because it resembles another word. It is not an error when the word’s meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree.

[P258] 所以他想找一【个】植物对药

[P259] 所以他想找一个植物【对药】
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以他想找一个植物[对药→这个药] (吃 needs a medicine object here)
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): [几棵植物→有的植物]可以是药

Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information. [P260] 【他】想把花放在茶里
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [-他]想把花放在茶里 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)

  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. [P261] 【对】药
  proposed by the correction model: [对→当]药

places.reason: 当药 is the normal collocation.
First mention needs a brief identifying noun phrase.
Plants can be eaten 当药, not 对药.
他们吃的植物 needs only the relative-clause 的.
病人 is a noun; the sentence needs the verb 生病.
可能 correctly expresses possibility with 特别有毒.
The predicate should be 有毒.
个 is an acceptable general measure word for a beginner.
当药 is the natural expression for serving as medicine.
The same subject continues and need not be repeated.
对药 is not the intended medicine expression.
